sections.Profile:
"Space Shuttle," released by Williams Electronics in November 1984, is a historically significant pinball machine credited with revitalizing the pinball industry during a time when video games were dominating the market. Designed by Barry Oursler and Joe Kaminkow, with artwork by Mark Sprenger, this game features a distinctive space theme centered around the NASA Space Shuttle program.

- Years made: 1984–1986
